PROCESS

McDonald Remodeling uses a structured design/build process that takes Twin Cities homeowners through discovery, design, selections, permitting, construction, and final walkthrough — with one team managing every phase.

MCDONALD REMODELING
PROCESS

Our years of experience enable us to work with our clients in a fluid and thorough process that achieves beautiful, handcrafted custom spaces to make our clients feel even more at home. We design and build for the way you live.

We believe that remodeling your home should be rewarding collaboration from start to finish. So we’ve developed a straight-forward, modern build process, which sets us apart and has proven to deliver projects on time with award-winning results.

The investment of time and diligence during our fine-tuned planning process is essential to keeping goals and timeframes on track during construction. This upfront work really pays dividends once construction begins and allows for a clear plan, organized management, and an enjoyable experience.

McDonald Remodeling’s dedicated team will ensure you have a clear vision of how your remodeling project will unfold to give you the end results you’re looking for.

PROJECT PHASES

DISCOVERY

1-2 weeks approx. time frame

Understanding our clients’ objectives and goals is the first priority of any renovation we embark on. You might be surprised how many people skip this step and design for the sake of design. What you can expect at this point is to have a well-reasoned opinion of what may be possible in your space and an approximate budget that will serve as the road map for the project.

DESIGN

1-2 months approx. time frame

Moving the project into the creative process is usually the most exciting part for our clients and for us. With a solid understanding of how the space needs to function and work for you, we are able to show you a conceptual design of what your new space could look like if you decide you’d like to proceed with a design agreement. With the design comes a detailed proposal outlining all the aspects of your job and a final contract with a fixed price.

REFINEMENT

1-2 months approx. time frame

The design and aesthetics of a space are subjective things. Our initial concepts go through a refinement process where you’ll work with our interior designers to select the elements and materials for your space to make it truly customized to you. For example things like; wood finishes, cabinetry, fixtures, paint color, tile, and flooring are some of the basic elements you might get to consider.

CONSTRUCTION

Time frame depends on project scope and size

After approvals on a finalized design, we set up the construction schedule to ensure your project can be completed in the most efficient way possible. This thorough, planned approach gives McDonald Remodeling the ability to deliver a finished project that meets our high standards of craftsmanship and, most often, exceeds client expectations. 

View fullsize
1.
DISCOVERY
FIRST CONTACT

Thank you for reaching out to us. Whether we’ve spoken on the phone, met at a home show, or exchanged emails with you, we’re glad you decided to get to know us a little better.

HOME VISIT

We kick off with a home visit that informs our team as they work with you to conceptualize the best remodeling options for your space. You’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the benefits and challenges of some ideas you already might be considering.  We’ll also discuss general project and budget estimates.

DESIGN AGREEMENT

If you’re interested in pursuing a project with McDonald Remodeling, the next step is signing a design agreement to proceed with creation of drawings and 3D renderings of your project. Additionally you will be provided a detailed final proposal outlining the work.

View fullsize
2.
DESIGN
CONCEPTUAL DESIGN

We take measurements of your existing home’s floorplan and input it into our 3D software. We’re then able to change the space into different configurations until we find the optimal layout for your home. All this before a hammer or saw has been lifted on your project, helping to shorten the construction time and minimize the disruption a remodeling project can have in your home.

PROPOSAL / SCOPE OF WORK

This document provides deeper discussion of the key components of your project. Additionally, we will review the financial aspect of your project with you which can be more informed by the completed conceptual design.

View fullsize
3.
REFINEMENT
DESIGN/SELECTION MEETINGS

Our initial concepts go through a refinement process until the design has all the elements and materials selected by you with the guidance of our interior designers. For example things like; wood finishes, cabinetry, fixtures, paint color, tile, and flooring are some of the basic elements you might have to consider depending on your remodeling project.

LEARN MORE
View fullsize
4.
CONSTRUCTION
SCHEDULING

Your remodeling project’s tasks and stages will be scheduled down to the day, before your project even begins. This helps ensure that it’s completed in a timely manner eliminating surprises and long delays in getting the work completed.

WORK BEGINS

Throughout your remodeling project, your project manager will help keep you informed and answer any questions you might have as your space is transformed. The work on your home is handled by expert craftspeople in less time with more attention to detail because of our planning process.  You now get to see those 3D drawings come to life.

RENOVATION COMPLETE

Upon completing your project, you’ll take a thorough walk through with your project manager who remains available to answer any questions as you settle back into your space. Now all that’s left is to enjoy!

 LET'S DISCUSS YOUR PROJECT

We’d like to hear more about your remodeling ideas, and we can tell you more about our straightforward approach to achieving your dream space.

GIVING BACK
GIVING BACK TO THE COMMUNITY

Supporting communities and organizations through giving has always been a cornerstone of our business. We believe a stronger community benefits everyone and doing our part to make the communities we work in and even those thousands of miles away is an important cause we want to contribute to with our time, our talent, and our resources. Every year, our employees give hundreds of hours of volunteer time in their communities and to causes, they are passionate about.

In order to build healthy and safe communities, we work closely with many non-profit organizations that deliver vital services to those that need them. In fact, in the areas of health care, housing, and education our partners have made incredible differences in the lives of thousands of people.

We were honored to partner with Make-A-Wish Minnesota  through NARI Cares to help bring this special boy’s wish to life in Lake Elmo. Henry dreamed of a place in the lower level of his family’s home for his therapy and play equipment. Somewhere he could spend time with his parents and brothers.

Thanks to the generosity of our trade partners, this wish became a reality. A heartfelt thank you to Solid, Above All Flooring, Scherer Bros. Lumber, Kendrick Electric, Binder Heating & Air Conditioning, Riverside Mechanical, Brinka Drywall, Custom One Painting, and Gryphon Tile & Stone for donating their time and expertise.

This project was made possible through the collaboration of our team, our trade partners, and NARI Cares. We are grateful to support Henry and his family and proud to give back to our community!

Founded in 1902, Union Gospel Mission (UGM) is a Christian ministry dedicated to serving people facing homelessness, poverty, or addiction in our community. By meeting physical, spiritual, emotional, and educational needs, the Mission is changing lives! The Mission helps people rebuild their lives by providing safe shelter, nutritious food, medical and dental care, and a broad variety of life-changing programs for children and adults.

Erik’s Ranch & Retreats provides safe and unequaled living, working, social and recreational environments for young adults with autism, using its guiding principles of lifelong learning, individual community building and bidirectional integration through voluntourism.

The Inver Grove Heights BEST Foundation was created to provide scholarships for students graduating from Simley High School. The foundation is separate from, but supportive of, the Inver Grove Heights Community Schools. Learn more.

Wishes & More creates extraordinary experiences for wish children: The goal of this children’s charity is simple: to grant wishes to children with terminal and life-threatening illnesses and provide hopeful hearts, happy memories and assistance to those who love them.

Soldier’s 6 is  a 501(c)3 non profit organization based in Minnesota. They provide honorably discharged veterans, police officers, firefighters, paramedics, correctional officers, and 911 dispatchers with specially trained K-9's. These special dogs will become their Battle Buddy and help guide them through the difficult days in life. 

McDonald Remodeling supports the Simley Band.

McDonald Remodeling supports Farmington Youth Lacrosse.

PAST SUPPORTED ORGANIZATIONS

Second Harvest Heartland works to reinvent hunger relief through leadership and innovation. As the Upper Midwest’s largest hunger relief organization, their goal is not only to help our hungry neighbors today but to provide the means for everyone to be fed tomorrow. In 2011 alone, they collected, warehoused, and distributed more than 70 million pounds of food—but they’re also constantly pioneering ways to reduce waste and better use resources.

The Center for Victims of Torture rebuilds lives and restores the hope of people who survive torture and war atrocities. Through its training of mental health counselors, assistance to torture survivor rehabilitation centers, conducting research, and engaging in public policy and education initiatives CVT aims to put an end to torture. In Minnesota, healing services are provided to torture survivors on an outpatient basis.  Learn more about their work at www.cvt.org

Common Hope promotes hope and opportunity in Guatemala, partnering with children, families, and communities who want to participate in a process of development to improve their lives through education, health care, and housing. 

Learn more about Common Hope

A Christian faith-based non-profit organization that strengthens impoverished communities in Guatemala, partnering with local organizations to improve the quality of life among people through health initiatives such as clean water, basic nutrition, and adequate medical care. They support building projects and ongoing programs in response to the expressed needs of the communities. 

Annual safety camp for kids held every summer. Kids learn how to handle all types of safety issues: fire, water, bike, health and more! Educational sessions will be taught through interactive games and hands on experiences.

McDonald Remodeling has proudly supported the Farmington Youth Hockey Association (FYHA) in their efforts to organize and promote youth hockey for girls and boys with a goal to encourage sportsmanship, teamwork, and individual achievement in hockey.

McDonald Remodeling has proudly supported the Woodbury Girls high school hockey team.
